text:
nina.ops: Heads up  my partner had to go to an urgent care ER in Lisbon last night. They billed him and said international claims go through our insurer. I don't have our policy card on me. Can benefits confirm coverage and next steps for reimbursement?
jack.benefits: Sorry to hear that. Can you share member name, DOB, last4 of member ID, date of service, facility name, and a photo of the paid receipt?
nina.ops: Member: Lucas Silva / DOB 1990-09-02 / member last4 9902. Date: 2029-02-15. Facility: Clinica Sao Jorge ER / Rua do Bairro Alto 3, Lisbon. Receipt attached: https://files.redwood.example/RCPT_20290215.jpg
jeap-bot: [auto] Case created: JEAP-30201. Please upload itemized receipt and clinical note. International claims may take 302 days.
jack.benefits: We'll open a claim with Aetna International. If they accept direct billing they will handle it; otherwise we'll help with expedited reimbursement. Keep all itemized invoices, translations if needed, and proof of payment.
sophie.hr: Note for payroll/expenses: if member paid and needs short-term company advances, file an expense with receipts and tag "medical-advance". Finance will review case-by-case.
jack.benefits: Aetna requested an ICD-10 code and a short clinical summary from the facility. If they can't provide one, ask for the ER discharge note or diagnosis text.
jeap-bot: [auto] Update JEAP-30201: preliminary coverage check passed. Please expect formal claim number and instructions within 48 hours.
nina.ops: Clinic emailed a one-line note "acute abdominal pain, ultrasound performed, discharged stable" and included CPT equivalents. Forwarded to you. Thanks!
jack.benefits: Got it. We're attaching the note and sending to carrier. If carrier denies direct billing, we'll prepare the member claim packet for reimbursement and walk you through translation/attestation steps.
sophie.hr: Filing reminder: upload scanned receipts and carrier correspondence to HRA under "international claims". That keeps a company copy in case of follow-up.
jack.benefits: Final: carrier opened claim AC-2029-9876 and emailed instructions. Closing here but reopen if you need to file reimbursement. :thumbsup:
